scripts.model:test: PYTHONPATH=services/api python3 -m unittest services/api/tests/test_spec_contract.py services/api/tests/test_stages.py services/api/tests/test_formulas.py services/api/tests/test_engine_baseline.py services/api/tests/test_regressions.py services/api/tests/test_repository.py
scripts.api:test: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --project services/api --extra test python -m unittest discover -s services/api/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.api:dev: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --project services/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.bootstrap: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --project services/api python services/api/scripts/bootstrap.py
scripts.data:backup: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --project services/api python scripts/backup_data.py
scripts.data:restore: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --project services/api python scripts/restore_data.py
